description: This file contains asynchronous functions to manage taxonomy data and mappings within a database. It provides methods to retrieve a nested taxonomy tree, upsert mappings for entities, and apply mappings to entities based on raw values, with specific focus on taxonomy hierarchy and entity-label mappings.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] get_full_taxonomy(session: AsyncSession)
methods.description: Fetches complete taxonomy hierarchy (L1, L2, L3) from the database and structures it into a nested dictionary.

methods.name: Mapping upsert_mapping(session: AsyncSession, raw_value: str, l1_id: Optional[int], l2_id: Optional[int], l3_id: Optional[int], kind: str = "entity")
methods.description: Creates or updates a mapping record linking a raw value to a taxonomy hierarchy level (L1, L2, L3).

methods.name: int apply_mappings_to_entities(session: AsyncSession, extraction_id: int)
methods.description: Applies existing mappings to entities associated with a given extraction ID, updating their taxonomy references based on the mappings.

ctags.name: apply_mappings_to_entities
ctags.pattern: /^async def apply_mappings_to_entities(session: AsyncSession, extraction_id: int) -> int:$/

ctags.signature: (session: AsyncSession, raw_value: str, l1_id: Optional[int], l2_id: Optional[int], l3_id: Optional[int], kind: str = "entity")
